tools.command: sole-research adapter approve STAGING --project PROJECT --reason TEXT --controller-token-file HUMAN_CAPABILITY_FILE
tools.summary: Record human review in an isolated generated adapter without installing it.
tools.output: JSON approval-record path and reviewed manifest hash.
side_effects: Writes approval.json inside the staging directory only.
limits: Verified project-bound human controller capability required.
Does not install, copy, register, or activate the adapter.
failure_modes: Agent capability, unknown manifest version, altered generated file, or existing approval fails closed.

tools.summary: Generate a deterministic harness adapter in an explicit isolated staging directory.
tools.output: JSON path, manifest hash, and generated file count.
side_effects: Creates only the absent or empty staging directory.
limits: Harness names are normalized lower-case hyphen-case.
Identical inputs produce identical generated bytes.
No installation or configuration writes.
failure_modes: Unsafe, symbolic-link, nonempty, reserved, or malformed target fails closed.

tools.summary: Verify a generated adapter byte-for-byte against deterministic shared contracts without executing staged code.
tools.output: JSON deterministic-contract result and verified manifest hash.
limits: No staged code execution, network, install, or project mutation.
Generated adapter must exactly equal generator-owned bytes and the packaged tool catalog.
failure_modes: Unknown versions, unexpected files, hash drift, invalid output, or subprocess failure fails closed.

tools.summary: Inspect, propose, or controller-apply typed graph operations.
tools.output: JSON graph diff, conflict, or reconciliation event data.
side_effects: propose appends a proposal; apply atomically mutates graph and outline.
limits: Only controller capability may apply.
Stale bases stay proposals.
failure_modes: Invalid operations, stale application, unresolved outline edits, or wrong authority fails closed.

actions.name: propose
side_effects: Appends a proposal.

actions.name: apply
side_effects: Atomically mutates graph/outline.

tools.summary: Record entity-scoped raw discussion turns and explicit candidate takeaways.
tools.output: JSON discussion entries or one appended turn/takeaway.
side_effects: add/promote append immutable entity-scoped discussion records.
limits: A promoted takeaway remains a proposal and never accepts or mutates graph semantics.
failure_modes: Unknown entity, malformed identity/content, or active-run writer bypass fails closed.

actions.name: add
side_effects: Appends discussion turn.

actions.name: promote
side_effects: Appends proposed takeaway only.

tools.summary: Validate runtime and optionally authoritative project state.
tools.output: JSON checks and ok boolean; process exits 1 when checks fail and 2 on contract errors.
limits: Never migrates or repairs project files implicitly.
failure_modes: Unknown schema, missing layout, or explicit migration requirement is emitted as structured stderr JSON.

tools.summary: List or record evidence resolved against inspected content at an exact locator.
tools.output: JSON evidence records or stable evidence ID plus created flag.
side_effects: add appends immutable exact-locator evidence.
limits: Content must already be inspected.
Excerpt and locator must resolve exactly and within configured bounds.
failure_modes: Discovery-only source, ambiguous locator, excerpt mismatch, source-version drift, or active-run writer bypass fails closed.

actions.name: add
actions.output: Stable evidence ID and created flag.
side_effects: Appends exact-locator evidence.

tools.summary: Create a deterministic portable audit bundle.
tools.output: JSON output path and canonical file count.
side_effects: Atomically creates a new export directory.
limits: Refuses overwrite and symbolic links.
Capabilities, caches, source copies, and raw transcripts are excluded.
failure_modes: Dirty outline, invalid project, unsafe destination, or existing destination fails closed.

tools.summary: Normalize source metadata or inspect bounded source content.
tools.output: JSON source IDs, count, and creation result.
side_effects: Writes source and extraction provenance; URL --inspect may use bounded HTTP(S).
limits: Tests are offline.
Remote inspection enforces vetted DNS, redirects, timeouts, pacing, attempts, and byte ceilings.
Private local inputs require local_private policy and --private.
failure_modes: Unsafe URL, redirect, content bound, malformed import, policy violation, or active-run writer bypass fails closed.

actions.name: import
actions.output: Source IDs, count, and creation result.
side_effects: Writes normalized source/extraction provenance; URL inspection may use bounded HTTP.

tools.summary: Atomically initialize an authoritative research project and external controller capabilities.
tools.output: JSON project ID, path, and external capability-record paths; token values are never printed.
side_effects: Creates project atomically and mode-0600 capabilities under external config root.
limits: Destination must not exist.
failure_modes: Existing path, unsupported policy, or capability creation failure leaves no partial project.

actions.name: init
actions.output: Project identity and external capability paths.
side_effects: Creates project and external capabilities.

tools.summary: Explicitly migrate a supported historical project contract.
tools.output: JSON migration identity, before/after hashes, and resulting schema version.
side_effects: Atomically upgrades only the supported empty historical graph and appends migration provenance.
limits: Never runs implicitly; only the packaged v1-to-v2 outline metadata migration is supported.
failure_modes: Unknown version, nonempty untyped graph, invalid history, or interrupted third-state edit fails closed.

tools.summary: Rebuild the disposable SQLite index from authoritative files.
tools.output: JSON index path and deterministic indexed counts.
side_effects: Atomically replaces only derived .soleresearch index state.
limits: Never writes canonical research files.
failure_modes: Invalid/tampered canonical state or unsupported schema fails closed without treating the old index as authoritative.

tools.summary: Reconcile human Markdown edits into graph state while preserving visible conflicts.
tools.output: JSON reconciliation event, revisions, changes, and conflict IDs.
side_effects: Atomically updates graph/outline metadata and appends reconciliation events.
limits: Human semantics win; anchors retain stable identity.
failure_modes: Wrong authority, duplicate/orphan/missing anchors, or concurrent third-state edits queue or fail visibly.

tools.summary: Create the first human-accepted graph question and anchored outline section.
tools.output: JSON node ID, applied diff ID, and graph revision.
side_effects: Atomically adds one question and projects the outline.
limits: Produces outline structure, not paper prose.
failure_modes: Invalid capability, dirty outline, or existing writable run bypass fails closed.

tools.command: sole-research serve PROJECT [--workspace-dir DIR] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--allowed-host HOST] [--edit --controller-token-file HUMAN_CAPABILITY_FILE]
tools.summary: Serve one project or an explicit directory of independent question projects from authoritative files.
tools.output: Loopback HTTP UI; JSON APIs expose the registered question workspace, project-scoped read state, and outline ETags.
side_effects: Edit mode may atomically write outline.md and one human-edit event at a clean human gate.
limits: Workspace discovery is limited to immediate non-symlinked project directories.
Only the primary project may be annotated in an edit-enabled server session.
Read-only by default; non-loopback requires explicit unsafe acknowledgement and can never edit in v1.
failure_modes: Invalid host, capability, CSRF token, ETag, outline anchors, or active-run gate fails closed.

tools.summary: Inspect sources and maintain transparent reading/quality dimensions.
tools.output: JSON sources, reading queue, or updated source record.
side_effects: read/quality update canonical source state and regenerate the reading queue.
limits: Quality remains separate dimensions; no opaque score.
failure_modes: Unknown source, invalid dimension, or active-run writer bypass fails closed.

actions.name: queue
side_effects: Regenerates the human-readable queue projection.

actions.name: read
side_effects: Updates reading state.

actions.name: quality
actions.output: Updated source record with separate dimensions.
side_effects: Updates explicit quality dimensions.
failure_modes: No dimension or invalid value fails closed.

tools.summary: Report authoritative project counts or bounded run state.
tools.output: JSON project counts/outline state or run state, gate, budget, remaining envelope, pending tasks, and Git policy.
side_effects: Run status accounts elapsed time and may durably pause a newly reached hard cap.
limits: No hidden repair or migration.
failure_modes: Unknown project/run/schema or tampered ledger fails closed.

tools.summary: Expose the versioned harness-neutral tool contract and canonical result preflight.
tools.output: Strict JSON tool catalog, one tool specification, or result-validation receipt.
limits: Unknown schema/catalog versions and unknown IDs fail closed.

Structural-only result preflight remains available; optional worker-bundle preflight also validates task, scope, provenance, reservation, and trusted receipt-time relationships without admitting a result.
failure_modes: Invalid packaged catalog, unknown tool ID, unreadable JSON, or invalid result emits structured stderr JSON.

actions.name: validate-result
actions.output: Canonical packaged result validation receipt; bundle-aware mode explicitly reports that broker admission did not occur.
failure_modes: Unreadable, malformed, semantically invalid, out-of-task, expired, or provenance-invalid result fails closed.

tools.summary: Prepare citation files and a deterministic human-review manifest for manual Zotero import.
tools.output: JSON output path, manifest hash, CSL item count, duplicate/identity diagnostics, and pending review status.
side_effects: Atomically creates a new local bundle directory.
limits: Never contacts or mutates Zotero.
Refuses overwrite and symbolic links.
failure_modes: Invalid project/reference JSON, unsafe destination, or existing destination fails closed.

tools.summary: Inspect or explicitly extend the active run envelope.
tools.output: JSON limits, consumption, remainder, or extension record.
side_effects: extend appends a reasoned bounded extension and updates limits.
limits: No implicit extension; cumulative delta is bounded to one initial envelope.
failure_modes: Wrong controller, empty reason, nonpositive/overbound delta, or incompatible unit fails closed.

actions.name: extend
side_effects: Appends extension and updates bounded limits.

tools.summary: Inspect and resolve review gates, ratify Sol changes, or switch control at a clean gate.
tools.output: JSON gate, decision, ratification, controller, or cycle state.
side_effects: Mutating actions append auditable run events and may apply reviewed graph diffs.
limits: Human authority is required for human acceptance/ratification.
Controller switch and cycle advance require a clean gate.
failure_modes: Wrong authority, stale result, pending task/decision, or terminal run fails closed.

actions.name: resolve
actions.output: Reviewed result decision and graph diff.
side_effects: Applies/rejects one pending result.

actions.name: ratify
side_effects: Upgrades accepted authority to human.
failure_modes: Agent capability or unknown diff fails closed.

actions.name: switch-controller
side_effects: Switches controller at clean gate.

actions.name: advance-cycle
side_effects: Consumes one cycle at clean gate.

tools.summary: Create and operate one files-first bounded research run.
tools.output: Strict JSON manifest/status, immutable task, admitted result, lifecycle state, or local checkpoint.
side_effects: Writes run ledgers and brokered canonical proposals/changes; optional Git mode creates only a dedicated local worktree/branch and checkpoints.
limits: Balanced maximum: 3 cycles, 10 tasks, 15 deep sources, 4 agents including the orchestrator, depth 1, 90 minutes, explicit provider ceiling.
A run needs at least 2 agent slots to dispatch one worker.
Workers receive selected context and logical references only.
No merge or push operation exists.
failure_modes: Second writer/run, cap, stale/malformed packet, expired lease, provenance mismatch, unsafe context, or wrong controller fails closed.

actions.name: start
actions.output: Immutable run manifest and active state.
side_effects: Creates one bounded run and optional isolated worktree.
failure_modes: Existing writable run/invalid envelope/Git baseline fails closed.

actions.name: dispatch
side_effects: Consumes task budget and reserves usage.

actions.name: bundle-task
actions.output: Integrity-bound secret-free task, assigned source/evidence material, result schema, and result template.
side_effects: Writes one new immutable worker bundle and never overwrites an existing output.
failure_modes: Unknown task/artifact, wrong controller, output collision, or secret/path leakage fails closed.

actions.name: import-result
actions.output: Admitted result and proposed/applied graph diff.
side_effects: Consumes admitted usage and records result.

actions.name: expire-leases
side_effects: Appends expiry events and releases reservations.

actions.name: cancel-task
side_effects: Appends cancellation event.
failure_modes: Nonpending task/empty reason/wrong controller fails closed.

actions.name: requeue-task
side_effects: Consumes task budget and records lineage.

actions.name: pause
side_effects: Pauses timing and appends event.

actions.name: finish
side_effects: Finishes run and appends event.

actions.name: checkpoint
side_effects: Commits only explicit paths in bound run worktree.

tools.summary: Resume an explicitly paused run when its cause is cleared.
tools.output: JSON active run state.
side_effects: Updates run state/budget timing and appends a resume event.
limits: Hard-cap pauses require an explicit valid extension first.
failure_modes: Wrong controller, terminal/active state, unresolved gate, or uncleared cap fails closed.
